work_items.title: Set up AWS infrastructure
work_items.description: Configure AWS environment for RDS, S3, SQS, and Fargate services, ensuring security groups and IAM roles are established for all services.

work_items.title: Implement Service Worker with Workbox
work_items.description: Create Service Worker using Workbox to handle offline caching mechanisms for the PWA, ensuring assets are appropriately cached.

work_items.title: Create IndexedDB schema for offline submissions
work_items.description: Design and implement the schema for IndexedDB to store offline submissions, including tracking submission status and retry logic.

work_items.title: Spring Boot with SQS integration
work_items.description: Develop and configure the Spring Boot backend to receive messages from SQS for async processing of offline submissions.

work_items.title: Build mobile form with global barcode listener
work_items.description: Create a mobile form allowing warehouse staff to scan damaged items, input damage details, and submit them offline.

work_items.title: Implement photo compression (Canvas API)
work_items.description: Integrate photo compression functionality within the mobile form, ensuring that images are saved in the correct format and size before submission.

work_items.title: Implement background sync with retry logic
work_items.description: Develop the logic for background syncing of offline submissions to the server when connectivity is restored, including handling retrials on failure.

work_items.title: Implement SQS processing for SAP validation
work_items.description: Build the logic to validate submitted items against SAP using data retrieved from SQS, transitioning statuses appropriately.

work_items.title: Enhanced supervisor dashboard
work_items.description: Create a dashboard for supervisors to review and manage validated write-off requests with options for approval or rejection.

work_items.title: Audit logging for offline-to-online transitions
work_items.description: Implement audit logging to track actions taken on offline submissions, specifically during transitions to online state.

work_items.title: Build SAP sync job with monitoring
work_items.description: Create a background job to handle syncing approved write-offs to SAP, implementing monitoring and failure handling mechanisms.

work_items.title: Token refresh implementation
work_items.description: Implement token refresh logic in the application to maintain user sessions aligned with 12-hour shifts, ensuring seamless transitions.

work_items.title: Test the offline scenario in a warehouse mock environment
work_items.description: Conduct offline scenario testing in a controlled environment to validate the functionality of all features under offline conditions.

work_items.title: Conduct load testing
work_items.description: Perform load testing on the system to review the performance under peak loads of 200 daily submissions, ensuring stability and responsiveness.

work_items.title: Security review of local encryption
work_items.description: Review the implementation of local encryption for sensitive data stored in IndexedDB, ensuring compliance with organizational policies.

work_items.title: Production deployment with data migration
work_items.description: Deploy the system to production and handle any necessary data migration tasks to ensure continuity.
